story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them. He is 1-2 with 397.00 points, fifth in the league.

The losses were close. 113.10 to 127.06 against YesChef23 in Week 1, and 127.74 to 139.80 against Hades9mm in Week 3. The win was a 156.16 to 110.60 beat-down of Sarge71 in Week 2, with Dak Prescott leading at 29.76. Efficiency is 80.8 percent, which leaves room for more.

The quarterback room is the open question. Aaron Rodgers arrived as an autopick, was moved to free agency, and the Week 3 move was a swap involving Drew Lock and Geno Smith. Jonathan Taylor did the real work. The 1.09 slot says the roster has a good best case, and the record says it has not been realized.
